question: What exactly does Goedegebuure2024 report for non-ligatured mi with URBS, and how does her proposed city analysis differ from a name analysis?
review_questions: Are all four selected Table1 fields and source locators transcribed faithfully, with the two different question-mark scopes preserved?
Does the proposed lexical analysis follow from the argument, and what counterevidence or alternative analyses should remain attached?
Can earlier name analyses and exact inscription loci be consulted independently before describing a fully collated competing-edition pair?

source_requirements.citation: Petra M. Goedegebuure (2024), The Luwian word for city, town, Anatolian Studies74,47–73. DOI10.1017/S0066154624000085.

locators.inspection: All four Table1 rows visually checked
§4.4 and reported alternatives text and rendered page checked
Conclusion and proposed analysis visually checked

source_requirements.rights: CC BY4.0, explicit publisher statement on printed p.47. Attribution required; these selected text-table assertions retain CC BY4.0 and are not relicensed CC BY-NC. Third-party photographs/figures and full edition apparatus are excluded.

remaining_gates: Independent linguistic/epigraphic review of the proposed analysis
Direct consultation of the earlier analyses and inscription editions
Exact native-entry/object joins and graphical geometry if required
boundary: Packet preparation and structural validation do not authenticate expertise, source independence or epigraphic truth. No outreach is sent.
